- Initial release of the customs-hts-classification-mece skill.
- Provides structured step-by-step guidance for classifying merchandise under the HTSUS using the General Rules of Interpretation (GRI) in a MECE framework.
- Includes clear activation criteria and when not to use (if a binding ruling exists).
- Offers compliance anchors, red flags, verification checklist, and example scenarios.
- Designed for use by brokers and compliance teams to ensure a defensible, reasoned customs classification process.
